mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_task (subscription_id, channel, scheduled_at, status, retry_count, idempotent_key) VALUES (#{subscriptionId}, #{channel}, #{scheduledAt}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{idempotentKey})
mapper.select: SELECT id, subscription_id, channel, scheduled_at, status, sent_at, retry_count, error_message, idempotent_key, created_time FROM notify_task WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, subscription_id, channel, scheduled_at, status, sent_at, retry_count, error_message, idempotent_key, created_time FROM notify_task WHERE idempotent_key = #{idempotentKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, subscription_id, channel, scheduled_at, status, sent_at, retry_count, error_message, idempotent_key, created_time FROM notify_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND scheduled_at <= NOW() ORDER BY scheduled_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_task SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE notify_task SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE notify_task SET subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, status = 'PENDING', sent_at = NULL, retry_count = 0, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CANCELLED'
